description: Downloads a public URL and returns the title, meta description, canonical URL, Open Graph tags, headings, links count and the main readable text (scripts, styles and navigation stripped), truncated to maxChars. 0.005 USDC per call via x402.

paymentProof.description: Payment proof: USDC tx hash on Polygon or Base (0x...) or Solana tx signature. Omit on the first call to receive the 402 payment instructions, pay, then call again with the proof.

name: web_extract
